comment: The single source of truth for the CI-gate vulnerability-scanner set.
A candidate is clean when every scanner in this list says so; policy
and docs read this list and never hard-code a scanner count or name.
Three independent scanners with DELIBERATELY DIFFERENT database
lineages, so a miss in one is caught by another:
- grype        : Anchore vulnerability DB (GitHub Security Advisories,
- trivy        : Aqua trivy-db (aggregated distro + language advisories).
- osv-scanner  : the OSV.dev database (osv-scalibr; deps.dev), for the
Decision register row 44 (Sep 21): Snyk left the CI gate and OSV-Scanner
took its slot; the retired 'Trivy leaves on the first green-Snyk gate'
trigger (register row 18) no longer applies. Snyk is not deleted - it
runs once per variant per day in the daily main-candidate rescan
(main-candidate-rescan.yml), inside the Snyk Free plan's container
quota, and is NOT part of this gate list.
